title.original: FSA: An Alternative Efficient Implementation of Native Sparse Attention Kernel
title.zh: FSA：原生稀疏注意力内核的一种高效替代实现
title.en: FSA: An Alternative Efficient Implementation of Native Sparse Attention Kernel

inclusion_reason.zh: FSA 提供适配主流小 GQA 分组的开源 NSA kernel，可直接复用于训练和推理后端。
inclusion_reason.en: FSA provides an open NSA kernel adapted to mainstream small GQA groups for direct reuse in training and inference backends.

abstract.zh: FSA 重写 Native Sparse Attention 的 GPU kernel 循环顺序，使其在每个 GQA 组只有少量查询头的主流模型上仍能高效执行。
abstract.en: FSA rewrites the GPU-kernel loop order for Native Sparse Attention so it remains efficient on mainstream models with few query heads per GQA group.

problem.zh: 原生 NSA kernel 只有在每个 GQA 组包含较多查询头时利用率高，而现有 LLM 普遍采用更小分组，限制了算法落地。
problem.en: The original NSA kernel is efficient only with many query heads per GQA group, whereas deployed LLMs commonly use smaller groups, blocking practical adoption.

approach.zh: 作者设计替代的 Flash Sparse Attention kernel，重新映射查询头、稀疏块和 GPU 工作单元，以覆盖不同 GQA 组大小。
approach.en: The authors design an alternative Flash Sparse Attention kernel that remaps query heads, sparse blocks, and GPU work units across a wider range of GQA group sizes.

system_design.zh: 稀疏索引与 KV 块进入新的任务布局，调度层按头数配置线程块，kernel 完成稀疏加载、注意力计算与输出归并，并接入训练和 prefill 路径。
system_design.en: Sparse indices and KV blocks enter a new task layout, scheduling configures blocks from head count, and the kernel performs sparse loads, attention, and output reduction for training and prefill paths.

key_results.zh: FSA 在多种主流模型上降低 NSA kernel 时延，并把内核级收益传递为训练与 prefill 的端到端加速。
key_results.en: FSA lowers NSA kernel latency across mainstream models and carries those kernel gains into end-to-end training and prefill speedups.

limitations.zh: 方法只优化 NSA 这一稀疏模式并继承其精度假设；不同稀疏率、GPU 架构和解码工作负载仍需单独调优。
limitations.en: The method targets NSA and inherits its accuracy assumptions; different sparsity ratios, GPU generations, and decode workloads still need separate tuning.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
